Maya Patel: Heads up — Emerald AI invoice INV-2026-03 (due 2026-03-01) still open. Billing shows 3 CC fails and one manual ACH attempt failed. Customer emailed asking for a 60-day split plan. cc @Keisha Rivera for collections

Finance Bot: payment_failure: account=emerald-ai invoice=INV-2026-03 attempts=3 last_attempt=2026-03-10 09:12 UTC

Keisha Rivera: I'm on it. Do we have any usage dispute or is this purely payment? Did CS escalate?

Maya Patel: No usage dispute in the ticket. CS (Jon) said they downgraded plan but usage aligned with invoice. Customer says cash flow tight, asked for split 60/30/10 across 3 installments.

Jon Huang: Confirmed. Ticket #3421 — Emerald AI open support thread. Customer also asked for invoice copy; attached link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-03.pdf

Keisha Rivera: Okay. My initial call: offer a 30/30/40? 60-day is long for us given risk. We should ask for card on file + one upfront payment.

Maya Patel: Balance $142,500. Risk: if we accept long plan we set precedent. Also legal requires SOW amendment for payment plans >30 days.

Keisha Rivera: Can legal pre-approve a 60-day term for high-value customers? @Legal Ops

Legal Ops: We can approve a structured plan if we get signed amendment and 3% late fee, plus revocation clause. Send proposed amendment, we'll fast-track.

Keisha Rivera: Drafting amendment. Proposed customer-facing email below:

``
Hi [Name],
We appreciate your note. To support you, we're prepared to offer a 3-installment payment plan: 30% now, 40% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days. This is contingent on (1) signed amendment agreement, (2) card on file or ACH authorization, and (3) 3% late fee on overdue installments.
Please confirm by EOD 2026-03-12 to lock this plan.

Regards,
Keisha Rivera
Redwood Finance
``

Maya Patel: Sounds reasonable. Ask for immediate payment >=30% to avoid churn.

Jon Huang: I'll ask CS to push for 30% now and attach payment link.

Finance Bot: invoice_update: INV-2026-03 status=payment-plan-pending due_next=2026-04-10

Keisha Rivera: If customer declines, escalate to collections and mark as 'final notice' in 7 days.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Action items: Keisha—send amendment + email. Jon—CS to collect 30% and card info. I'll flag renewal and revenue impact to rev ops.

Jon Huang: On it. I'll post update when payment collected.

Keisha Rivera: Draft sent to Legal for sign-off, ETA 24h.

Maya Patel: Thanks. If no response by 2026-03-16, we proceed with escalation. :warning: 

Jon Huang: Noted.
